descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S19 A raw server error never reaches the screen, and no browser alert pops up

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state. (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 3)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Standard fixture; the resident is seeded with a generated note; the harness makes the summary, Ask AI and billing calls fail with a raw message

When Hospital: type a pre-round line and press Save Note; ask Ask AI a question. Nursing Home: ask Ask AI; open Post-Round (billing)

Then Each screen shows the app's own plain message; none of the raw error text, error class names, stack frames or request ids appear, and no browser dialog opens

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U12 'no raw error pop-up': every checkpoint mustNotContain 'QA-RAW-7731', 'Uncaught', 'ConvexError', 'Server Error', 'at handler', 'Request ID' and has a positive anchor so it cannot pass on the wrong screen: cp1 the typed line and a failure word; cp2/cp3 the Ask AI sheet title 'Ask About This Patient', the asked question (still in the box, U13) and a failure word; …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.
